reviews.text: The staff was welcoming,  which is always nice.  I was able to get an early check in. Breakfast is 6-9 and the bar/ restaurant is 5-9 I believe. I wasn't a fan on my room. Seemed a bit outdated. I had a small balcony, but couldn't keep the door open because there was no screen. The cute round like couch in the room needed a cleaning and the room seemed a bit small. Good thing it was only me. The upside; there are plenty of places to eat. Walking distance!

I want to say that when we first walked it felt so nice and clean. We’re moving my sister, so when we came back from packing we were well greeted by Jenny. After packing all we wanted to do was get a drink and relax. Jenny was so nice and we had such a nice time chatting with her and just feeling like we were hanging out, comfortable and Jenny was our host. She took such good care of us. Thank you so much Jenny! We will always remember how you made us feel welcomed and loved!!!

My stay here was amazing no complaints room was spacious enjoyed the balcony view! The housekeeper Lita was awesome I used room 215 yesterday and she gave me extra coffee and towels since I had late check out.  She had informed me to do review and I just wanted to kindly thank her for working and servicing my needs.  You are appreciated more then you know! Thank you Lita you rock!
Tee

Nice hotel. Secluded so not a lot of traffic noise. Close to jump on freeway. Easy trips to airport, AT&T Stadium, Global Life Stadium, Six Flags. Friendly staff, large nice tv, comfy bed, nice outdoor pool. Only complaint...had to let shower run for a bit to get hot water (very odd).

The driver had a bit of an attitude, not toward me, but to a man who attempted to get on the shuttle at the next terminal. He was in his 70s (I think) and had a walking stick. My stay here has been great. Especially a huge compliment to Jenny at the Bistro! She had incredible hospitality and went above and beyond to make our experience amazing. She got our food out right away and genuinely cared about making our day better. Jenny is the kind of person who makes Marriott stand out — truly exceptional service!

I stayed here with my brother for a couple of days this month. We were in town for our dad's 90th birthday. Place was very nice, clean and accommodating. The pool was clean and well taken care of. Jenny, the bartender was the highlight. She …

Stayed at this Courtyard by Marriott in Bedford for a 3 day business trip. Check-in was quick and easy. There is a Cafe for breakfast that serves Starbucks coffee and muffins etc for breakfast. There is a Chili's right across from the hotel …

So glad to finally get out of Dallas Fort Worth Airport after 12 hours and to land there greeted courteously and given a room promptly. The room was clean in the bed divine. I hadn’t had a good night sleep like that and I don’t know how long. Jenny in the bistro Outstanding I was hungry. There wasn’t much to pick from, but she took care of me so well. Was able to eat something and go to sleep easily. Thank you for my stay after trying day in the airport.

Stayed for two nights for a solo vacation. The location and general amenities were what you'd expect from Courtyard. A comfortable bed and decent services. However, the first night was disappointing due to multiple palmetto bugs on the wall and floor of my room! While I understand this can be an issue in certain climates, it's not something you expect to encounter inside a “well-maintained” hotel room. Staff were courteous and brought me new rooms keys to my room.

When we walked in the room seemed fine.  We noticed a large burn mark in the carpet.  As I got in to bed I noticed a strong mildew smell.   After showering this morning the mildew smell was even stronger. We chose Marriott since my husband used them exclusively when we worked and traveled.   I think it is time for another remodel.  Also, when we got home all the clothes in the suitcase smelled of mildew!
I was there because of flight delays. The service was excellent from the moment I walked in. They have a nice Bistro on site. Jenny was awesome. She cooked up a great plate of wings.

Incredible hospitality from the staff here!! We were amazed to say the least. Katina the boss lady spent so much time making sure my wife and I had the perfect visit for our anniversary...and it was great. We fell in love with Jenny at the Bistro, she was incredible. The place was tip top and took they took care of us traveling Cowboys fans. We will stay here next time , TY Marriot

Stayed one night, lobby was updated but the rooms are incredibly outdated. My room smelled like paint thinner, shower didn’t drain, bathroom door knob was falling off, and the door would slam  into the wall when opening them. The “bistro” Starbucks coffee was not good and the front desk people seemed inconvenience when I was checking out. Overall, one night is the max I would do.

reviews.text: The staff was welcoming,  which is always nice.  I was able to get an early check in. Breakfast is 6-9 and the bar/ restaurant is 5-9 I believe. I wasn't a fan on my room. Seemed a bit outdated. I had a small balcony, but couldn't keep the door open because there was no screen. The cute round like couch in the room needed a cleaning and the room seemed a bit small. Good thing it was only me. The upside; there are plenty of places to eat. Walking distance!
reviews.author: Shernanya Taylor

reviews.text: I want to say that when we first walked it felt so nice and clean. We’re moving my sister, so when we came back from packing we were well greeted by Jenny. After packing all we wanted to do was get a drink and relax. Jenny was so nice and we had such a nice time chatting with her and just feeling like we were hanging out, comfortable and Jenny was our host. She took such good care of us. Thank you so much Jenny! We will always remember how you made us feel welcomed and loved!!!
reviews.author: Kathleen Rodriguez

reviews.text:
My stay here was amazing no complaints room was spacious enjoyed the balcony view! The housekeeper Lita was awesome I used room 215 yesterday and she gave me extra coffee and towels since I had late check out.  She had informed me to do review and I just wanted to kindly thank her for working and servicing my needs.  You are appreciated more then you know! Thank you Lita you rock!
Tee
reviews.author: Beautifultee

reviews.text: Upon our arrival, we were greeted with a big smile at the front desk and a quick check-in . When we got to our room, it was a bit warm, and we couldn't adjust the temperature. I called the front desk, and the property's engineer, Edwin, was in our room in 4 minutes fixing the problem. This made me ask him how many engineers there were on the property, since I had seen him shampooing the carpets in the hallways, picking up trash, and doing other things. When he replied that he was the only one, I was amazed by the priority they give to guests and the excellent condition in which they maintain the rooms and the property. The hallways smelled fresh.
reviews.author: Luis Castillo

reviews.text: Colton is beyond extraordinary! He proved time and again that he is willing to go above and beyond to accommodate his customers but also just has an essence of kindness and respect shown to every person. If I could give me more than five stars, I would with no hesitation! This was my first time needing a hotel based on delayed flights and as soon as I walked in and spoke with him, my nerves were gone and I felt cared for. He is truly an asset to the team and a wonderful person. Keep shining bright!
reviews.author: Kierstan Trost

reviews.text: Nice hotel. Secluded so not a lot of traffic noise. Close to jump on freeway. Easy trips to airport, AT&T Stadium, Global Life Stadium, Six Flags. Friendly staff, large nice tv, comfy bed, nice outdoor pool. Only complaint...had to let shower run for a bit to get hot water (very odd).
reviews.author: Justin Christensen

reviews.text: I was booked here for one night by American Airlines due to a delayed, then cancelled, flight. The hotel shuttle arrived right around 8:30 pm as promised by AA. The driver had a bit of an attitude, not toward me, but to a man who attempted to get on the shuttle at the next terminal. He was in his 70s (I think) and had a walking stick. The driver didn't get out to open the door and help him. The man fell whilst trying to get into the shuttle. Once at the hotel, the very handsome man who checked me in was quite helpful. I was starving, so I quickly ordered the Bistro Burger to take to my room. Both women who were working the Bistro were very kind and courteous. The food was brought out promptly and I was surprised at how good it was. The room was fine. Unlike others who have seen roaches, I didn't. The bed was comfy and the room was clean.
reviews.author: Randy Portwood

reviews.text:
We got to the room later in the evening after a full day or work and travel, we were ready for bed. We walked into our room and were hit in the face with a terrible musty moldy smell. It smelt like the room had flooded and then just sat there unattended. I have asthma and am allergic to mold, so this made the situation very unsafe for me!
We stayed in the room the 1st night due to not thinking we had much of an option. The next morning, I went to the front desk to see what could be done. I was grateful Katina was very helpful in getting me a new room. Although she was a bit rude to my father who was there visiting with us. Unfortunately, we were there with a team and multiple team members has to move due to similar issues as well as bed bugs & water seeping through the walls. One morning we literally walked through a puddle of water in the middle of the hallway to get to the lobby. There were no fans running or anything just wet squishy carpet. Ultimately, I will never stay there again!
reviews.author: Nicole Bukucs

reviews.text: My stay here has been great. Especially a huge compliment to Jenny at the Bistro! She had incredible hospitality and went above and beyond to make our experience amazing. She got our food out right away and genuinely cared about making our day better. Jenny is the kind of person who makes Marriott stand out — truly exceptional service!
reviews.author: Bella Nelson

reviews.text: I stayed here with my brother for a couple of days this month. We were in town for our dad's 90th birthday. Place was very nice, clean and accommodating. The pool was clean and well taken care of. Jenny, the bartender was the highlight. She was extremely nice, friendly and attentive. She makes a killer Old Fashion too if that's your thing. Can't beat the quality for the price point. Would happily recommend.
reviews.author: mattmZ4449GB

reviews.text: Staff here is extremely polite and patient to a fault. I've seen Jenny at the bar maintain a level head while getting scolded by multiple patrons all making irrational demands and being outright intolerable due to delayed flights etc. (Obviously not Marriotts fault) Outside of that after staying at multiple courtyards over the years I can confidently say that the kitchen here has some of the best food/drinks I've had at a courtyard, thanks again to jenny for that! The only slight complain I would have is that the rooms are slightly outdated.
reviews.author: Conner Inch

reviews.text: Stayed at this Courtyard by Marriott in Bedford for a 3 day business trip. Check-in was quick and easy. There is a Cafe for breakfast that serves Starbucks coffee and muffins etc for breakfast. There is a Chili's right across from the hotel and a Chick-fil-A and a few other fast food places within walking distance.  Rooms were quiet and comfortable. Location is safe. This Courtyard is about 20 minute drive to DFW airport. Overall good stay.
reviews.author: AeronauticalEngineer

reviews.text: So glad to finally get out of Dallas Fort Worth Airport after 12 hours and to land there greeted courteously and given a room promptly. The room was clean in the bed divine. I hadn’t had a good night sleep like that and I don’t know how long. Jenny in the bistro Outstanding I was hungry. There wasn’t much to pick from, but she took care of me so well. Was able to eat something and go to sleep easily. Thank you for my stay after trying day in the airport.
reviews.author: Sandra Liebert

reviews.text:
Stayed for two nights for a solo vacation. The location and general amenities were what you'd expect from Courtyard. A comfortable bed and decent services. However, the first night was disappointing due to multiple palmetto bugs on the wall and floor of my room! While I understand this can be an issue in certain climates, it's not something you expect to encounter inside a “well-maintained” hotel room. Staff were courteous and brought me new rooms keys to my room.

After checking out, I received an email from the hotels assistant general manager gifting me 1,000 Bonvoy points to my app which is an $8 value equivalent.

This Initial experience definitely has impacted my overall impression.
reviews.author: Veronica B

reviews.text: When we walked in the room seemed fine.  We noticed a large burn mark in the carpet.  As I got in to bed I noticed a strong mildew smell.   After showering this morning the mildew smell was even stronger. We chose Marriott since my husband used them exclusively when we worked and traveled.   I think it is time for another remodel.  Also, when we got home all the clothes in the suitcase smelled of mildew!
reviews.author: Beth's FavoriteRecipes

reviews.text: I was there because of flight delays. The service was excellent from the moment I walked in. They have a nice Bistro on site. Jenny was awesome. She cooked up a great plate of wings.
reviews.author: Jorge Ferguson

reviews.text: Incredible hospitality from the staff here!! We were amazed to say the least. Katina the boss lady spent so much time making sure my wife and I had the perfect visit for our anniversary...and it was great. We fell in love with Jenny at the Bistro, she was incredible. The place was tip top and took they took care of us traveling Cowboys fans. We will stay here next time , TY Marriot
reviews.author: Jim Crosson

reviews.text: Stayed one night, lobby was updated but the rooms are incredibly outdated. My room smelled like paint thinner, shower didn’t drain, bathroom door knob was falling off, and the door would slam  into the wall when opening them. The “bistro” Starbucks coffee was not good and the front desk people seemed inconvenience when I was checking out. Overall, one night is the max I would do.
reviews.author: Ryan Vierra

reviews.text: The staff at this hotel make the experience.  The hotel itself is mid-level, clean, rooms are decent and has good air conditioning. It's close to a lot of restaurants and about 10 min from the airport.  The staff was extremely helpful and supportive during our stay.  We had checked out early for our flight (5AM) and found out that Alaska had cancelled all flights due to a software issue.  At the airport and after rebooking with another airline for much later in the day, I called the front desk and they let us back into our room until check out and provided transport back from the airport. ||Upon leaving to go back to the airport, the front desk agent let us know their airport shuttle was not available, however, she arranged a Lyft to take us to the airport at no charge to us. ||We were pleasantly surprised by the level of care that the property staff displayed and for going, for us, above and beyond what we normally experience at any hotel, including other higher end ones.  If we return to the area, we will book again at this hotel.
reviews.author: lizbethw2015

reviews.text:
Don’t rely on the airport shuttle. In theory it runs every hour on the hour from the hotel. Our experience was quite different from that and ended up ubering after a long day of travel. Nobody at the desk seemed to know where the shuttle was but that it was in fact running. When we arrived the driver was taking a break in the lobby of the hotel.

Check in guys were nice and got things moving quick to get us to our room.

Room door didn’t fully latch, got stuck and had to pull closed.

In the morning for the certainly conveniently timed flight you’ll get when rebooked by the airline the shuttle left late and there was not complimentary coffee available. Full service starbucks was available.
reviews.author: Tobin Morse

reviews.text: A bit of a sprawling layout and we were about as far away from the front desk as was humanly possible. Thankfully not a big deal for us. The airlines chose the hotel when they cancelled our flight. There were a few restaurants close by. Thankfully, Chili's was still open when we arrived. The room was nice. We slept well and the staff was very friendly.
reviews.author: montanan_traveler

reviews.text: Katina showed excellent customer service. She even moved me to a closer room near my family without any hesitation. I will definitely be coming back to stay at this Courtyard By Marriott location. Keep up the awesome work!
reviews.author: Juan Pablo

reviews.text: Starbucks coffee service was terrible. Front desk service was good. The shower was dirty, the towels were awful, beds were hard, and the tv didn’t work.
reviews.author: Cody James

reviews.text: It was amazing. They changed our room for free so we had more space. They were very kind and helpful.
reviews.author: Sreejon Bhattacharya

reviews.text: One of my favorite courtyards, specially with Jenny serving food and drinks. The food was surprisingly good and the drinks were even better. Jenny’s impeccable and friendly service topped it all off.
reviews.author: Nick Abbott

reviews.text:
Last minute stop in at 11:30 and the attendant at front was very courteous and quick to help get me in the room.

Rooms are very clean and almost 0 outside noise with the interior courtyard.
reviews.author: Adam Berend

reviews.text:
Jenny at the bar/restaurant truly made our visit memorable. She went out of her way to ensure my wife and I felt well taken care of. Jenny is truly an asset to your organization!

I would also recommend you offer lemon pepper wings as option on your menu. 😃
reviews.author: First Last

reviews.text: The service upon arriving was great. I had just left another hotel (American Airlines did the booking), and this hotel was such a relief. There are some things that no longer feel modern but I don’t think it felt old either. Rooms was nice. Everything was clean. All amenities met expectations. The bed was super comfortable to me. I’m happy with stay. I could see why some others may rate this 4 stars, but the value in my book (though I didn’t pay) is also great compared to others in the area.
reviews.author: Noah Haygood

reviews.text: Jenny at the bar was amazing! She was so attentive and took care of so many of us! She needs a raise, and I can’t wait to come back because of her!
reviews.author: Kayla Davis

reviews.text:
MOST importantly, the driver of the shuttle spent the whole drive looking at photos of women on dating apps, rather creepily, as he drove. His eyes were on his phone more than the road. We did not feel safe, we were on the highway and he was swerving between lanes and stopping abruptly at the last second.

Front desk woman DOES NOT answer the phone. My husband and I called for an hour by room phone and cell phone without an answer. We had to be at the front desk to get any help. While at the desk, the phone rang constantly. Customers were even offering to answer it for her.

Shuttle to the airport only goes  on the hour. So when you need to be there by 7am you have to leave the hotel at 6AM. It takes only 20 minutes to get to the airport.

We got to stay for FREE bc of a delay with American Airlines. If this ever happens again, I would prefer to pay for a hotel than come here to be put at risk by the driver and treated poorly by staff.

One good note- the restaurant worker/bartender was amazing and sweet. She is the only thing right about this place.
reviews.author: Jenni Gustafson

reviews.text: I had a less than satisfactory experience at Marriott! Firstly  There were two bugs in the hall way for literally My whole stay which was disappointing and made me wonder about housekeeping I took this picture before leaving after being there for 2 1/2 whole days. I was not in the room all day on the second day of my stay and when I came back there had been no house keeping which I WASNT informed that they don’t offer house keeping unless specifically requested, ofcourse if you don’t tell people that they must request it then they won’t know! Because there was no house keeping we didn’t have clean towels or soap, they said they would bring some up! After waiting about 30 minutes I went down to get them because I had been out all day and needed to shower and they didn’t even have enough from laundry, they gave me a “drying towel, and a bath mat” no wash cloths available… I also had no soap in my bottle in the shower and when I went to request them I waited for about 30 additional minutes for Alex the engineer at the desk to say he has to go and get it because who ever he told to do it didn’t “know where it was” which makes me feel housekeeping at this location is lacking … no towels , can’t find soap ??? I mean come on now! I was very dissatisfied! Do no recommend
reviews.author: Sandra Cox

reviews.text: I stayed one night because my flight got delayed, the staff were amazingly cordial and sweet. Special shout out to Jenny who was single handedly taking care of the bar and cooking the food and serving everyone, with a big smile on her face... She was amazing and deserves a big fat raise... Also please hire more people so she gets some help... One person can only do so much, and she's doing everything
reviews.author: pranav gopal

reviews.text: The best part of our experience was Jenny in the bar/restaurant. She truly went above and beyond to take care of my husband and I. Not only did she provide stellar customer service, but she is an engaging conversationalist. We would return just for Jenny!
reviews.author: Jen Z

reviews.text: Assistant Manager Katina was the best. Not just with me but all the guest I saw her interact with. Very pleased.
reviews.author: Tamara Hunter

reviews.text: Took an hour for the airport shuttle to pick me and other passengers up. The room I got was on the first floor and was very muggy and smelled like cigarette smoke, which made it worse!  The sheets had other human's hairs on them and the bed mattress would sink excessively. Would not recommend!
reviews.author: Yvette P

reviews.text: I was here for a conference. The meeting room was quite nice, and the staff was very helpful when I got there and had questions.
reviews.author: Kaitlin cutiepie

reviews.text: The room was very dusty when coming in and the bathroom walls clearly have some mildew/mold starting to grow behind the wall paper with the ceiling above the shower peeling. Lobby renovation was nice enough but as others mentioned the restaurant was either closed most of the time during our stay or out of what we wanted to order. Outside of that the shower barely got luke warm. Service was the saving grace of the hotel with everyone being friendly and attentive.Location is not bad with plenty of restaurants and grocery stores in the area. All in all, three stars. Not awful but definitely room for improvement.
reviews.author: Brittany Betters

reviews.text: The front desk guy was nice but the bistro staff is bad. They don't care. They make everyone wait. In the morning, the lady was too busy reading her phone to even acknowledge me. After 5 minutes of standing right on front of her, I left. She didn't even look up!
reviews.author: Kim OBrien

reviews.text:
I arrived at the hotel today around 6 PM on 1/11/25, and I must say this has been the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had. I won’t name the front desk staff, but the service was absolutely terrible. The staff member was unfriendly, unprofessional, and clearly lacked basic knowledge of their job.

We had booked two rooms in advance, yet they failed to reserve them properly. As a result, we were given two rooms on completely different floors and opposite ends of the hotel, requiring us to cross the entire building. This level of incompetence is unacceptable, and staff like this should not be working in hospitality.

To make things worse, the elevators are nowhere near the lobby, and you have to walk a considerable distance to find them. The signage is almost nonexistent, making it extremely easy to get lost when moving around the property.

This has been the worst hotel we’ve ever stayed in, and I would strongly advise others to stay elsewhere.
reviews.author: Juan Yan

reviews.text: Had to move to another room because television stopped working. 2nd room seemed ok until the television did the same thing. Air conditioning unit in second room stopped working.  Downstairs in my Sister's room air barely worked and leaked on the carpet the whole stay. Highly disappointed in this property.
reviews.author: kimmiet870

reviews.text: We have had a very bad experience with this specific hotel. We got charged twice for our room and we reached out almost 3 weeks ago to try and dispute it to no avail. The manager sent us an email saying we would get refunded in 3-5 business days but it has been 11 days and no refund has been issued. The manager would not call us back to speak about it. The customer service supervisor also hung up on us.
reviews.author: ken Patel

reviews.text: Extra Friendly staff! GM Lisa is very kind. Very comfortable, clean rooms. The renovations are paying off. Location is great & close to everything. Halfway to both Dallas & Fort Worth. Everyone I encountered was very helpful. Trey & Shakina in particular. I will highly recommend to others if needing to stay in DFW area.
reviews.author: Climber07714709052

reviews.text: jenny best bar tender makes a great old fashion great service good times
reviews.author: Braeden McKinney

reviews.text: Checked in on May 2, 2025 and found baby German roaches in the bathroom, we were they for a basketball tournament and the other parent that stayed on the same floor found them in her room as well. We notified front desk and nothing happen, so my husband contacted the front desk to talk to the manager and was sent to her voicemail, he left her a message and she never returned the call. So he called back the gentleman who answered stated that she was out for the day at a meeting. So he explained what had happened to him and as soon as he stated that we had German roaches he hung up in my husband's face. So my husband contacted corporate to file a complaint to to get our reward points refunded for this bad experience. We have been staying a Marriott hotels since 2008 and this is the first bad experience we have ever had.
reviews.author: All Thingz U Need and More

reviews.text: Almost everything was GREAT BUT.. here we are 6:51AM and NO ONE tending ro the breakfast!!!!!... we have to be somewhere very early so we figured we could catch breakfast here.. I guess NOT!!!!
reviews.author: veronica Martinez

reviews.text:
This hotel is great! You can tell the Manager and the staff really care about the guests. Everyone was very friendly and accommodating.

I checked in with Kelly who was very sweet. They recently went under a renovation. A lot has improved from what I have seen.
reviews.author: Lisa Buccieri

reviews.text: We had one towel to our room and there was pee on the bathroom floor from the previous occupant. There was no soap and no other amenities. Skip this place, there’s literally 1,000 better hotels around Dallas. We walked the halls and there is construction tools and debris everywhere, yet no construction crew. This place screams DIY repairs. Don’t be fooled by the somewhat clean lobby, there’s literally rest of the place is a dump.
reviews.author: Matthew Seay

reviews.text: Milo and Alex - very poor shuttle service from the airport , both told me several times shuttle was on the way. Both lied. I ended up taking an Uber after waiting 1.5 hours for a 12 minute drive. The room was ok nothing special. I wouldn't recommend taking a shuttle. I spoke to the acting manager the next morning Olivia about the situation. Very unprofessional, rude and she wasn't helpful.
reviews.author: Robert Collum

reviews.text: Lobby area wasn’t bad but the rooms needed some updating and fixing. Restaurant service was out of almost everything I wanted to order. The bed dipped and the sheets had stains. The stand up shower drain was clogged so I could only take about a 3 minute shower before it started over flowing.
reviews.author: Z D

reviews.text: Stayed 6 nights, very clean and quiet. Polite / pleasant staff. Entrance renovation completed since last stay. Oatmeal with blueberries at the Bistro  excellent.  Will return next trip to the area.
reviews.author: Robert B

reviews.text:
Generally I try to make a rule that I do not write reviews while upset, but in this instance I feel the need to break that. The employees at this hotel are indifferent at best and incompetent at worst. I had the displeasure of staying here one night only. I arrived at 7:30pm, went straight to my room and did not leave again until 7:00am. During this time, my rental car keys were misplaced. Ok, my fault. I look throughout the room and ask the front desk agent to see if anyone had turned them in. He said no without looking. I asked him to call the employee from the day before. He said he did not have her number. I got an Uber to work and called literally every 30 minutes to one hour asking if they had been found. Asked them to notify housekeeping, construction, literally anyone. Asked them to review cameras. Not one person was kind or at all interested in helping. Finally I called a locksmith and paid the $350 to replace them chalking it up to my bad luck. I fly home. I get a call at 9:00pm. Magically they were found. The manager said “yes, we found them in the bistro area where you were sitting this afternoon”. I was sitting there while waiting for the locksmith. I truly believe they were found in the receptionist area that I asked them to check countless times and they are now trying to cover. I never entered that area until long after they were lost but regardless had someone had even one iota of kindness in them they could have been found or even if they hadn’t been found my experience would have been different.

If you have read this far, great, I have more. The hotel itself is unclean, they are undergoing renovations so there is construction everywhere. But don’t be fooled- it’s just a paint job and face lift. Nothing to fix the peeling paint, dirty floors and disgusting showers.

I travel to Dfw for work often and this is my second time staying here because it is close to work but never again. I would highly recommend no one waste their time. It is quite literally a stain on Marriott to be associated with this facility.
reviews.author: Heather Burns

reviews.text: Great location a few minutes from DFW airport and rental car center. Staff and service is exceptional. Very friendly. Terrible mushy soft pillows. Painting on 1st floor after 5pm...smell overwhelmed everywhere walking to room. Older Courtyard showing its age. Bistro still using plastic utensils!  If you are the owner of this hotel reading this...I will not be back!
reviews.author: Kent Bettisworth

reviews.text: Great room. Fantastic staff at the front desk and the lounge.
reviews.author: Meenakshi Sundaram

reviews.text: Stayed here a couple days ago, Debbie , she was very attentive and even went on a quest to find glasses I left behind. I’ll stay here any time I’m in the area. Thank you guys.
reviews.author: Oscar Gomez

reviews.text: Very clean, super friendly people working there. The lady Yolanda at the morning breakfast is super nice! Kirk and Arianna at the front desk definitely love what they do, very pleasant. Great spot to stay!!! I would stay here again for sure.
reviews.author: I3940YXjamesm

reviews.text: This was one of the worst places that we stayed. It wasn’t due to cleanliness or the area but the fact that the entrance doors don’t work. We were locked out several times and had to go all the way around to get back in. The bed is hard as a rock and the door is so close to the toilet. The toilet is also very low so my knees were practically at my chest. I went to do a load of laundry but there wasn’t an laundry detergent in the Market or in the back room so that was disappointing. Upside, the shower head is adjustable and the water is HOT! The outdoor seating area is very nice too. I also liked the couch in our room. That was quite comfortable. I wouldn’t stay here again though. It’s all just inconvenient.
reviews.author: Mrs Carley

reviews.text: Staff was great, and location is convenient with respect for the airport. Rooms are dated and have a damp musty feeling until the AC has been running. Shower area needs a deep clean or replacement, but rest of the room was in order.
reviews.author: Kip England

reviews.text: Room had a damp mildew smell. We were transferred to another room. This room has crickets. Front desk said they had the rooms sprayed. There were two in the room by the window; one by the side of the bed; one under the chair. Front desk said there was nothing they can do. Not easy trying to sleep and then you hear the chirping noise. Had I known this my selection would have been different. I can deal with the dated look but not the bugs crawling and hoping around. I’m so tired of the noise. Staff was nice.
reviews.author: Carol Wade

reviews.text: This is a great location to see the Cowboy game in the area! ||I came here for the Thanksgiving game! Ariana at the front desk was very sweet and helpful. Trey in the bistro made our food so fast! The building recently went through a renovation and you can tell the|Manger is working hard to turn things around.||Don’t worry about old reviews, things have changed!
reviews.author: lbooch95

reviews.text: I had the worse hotel experience here. The bed was infested with bed bugs. I woke up to bed bug bites all over my arms and hands after staying here. Not to mention the hallways smell like mildew. Do not waste your money at this horrible hotel facility!!
reviews.author: Latisha Moore

reviews.text: Good rooms for the price, service was good as well, good hotel to get near the airport and its a good location between dallas and fort worth. Unfortunately the pool wasn’t open during our stay.
reviews.author: Alex J

reviews.text: Colton at the front desk assisted me with modifying my reservation and was incredible
reviews.author: Johnathan Babineau

reviews.text: Place was under construction,  had little signs telling you to go around. Very disappointed in our stay.  Not worth the cost of the room. Maybe it will improve once they clean the place up. If we would have know about the construction would have stayed somewhere else.
reviews.author: Christopher Musick

reviews.text:
I would not recommend.

Pros : Price is low. good location (but maybe a bit too close of the highway noise through the windows). Friendly staff. The gym has been refurbished and is small but good. Access in / out of the hotel is convenient.

OK : breakfast has not a lot of options, but a real person is doing it for you.

Cons : the underlying infrastructure of the hotel is broke (plumbing, HVAC, Fire Detection Alarm, Wifi).

I had to reach three times to reception for various issues : the toilet water intake was closed so tank was not filling. Fixed on day 2, but then I understood why as it was leaking. I put a trash bin under it for the rest of my stay. The Fire alarm rang twice at 4am in my room, woke me up. The HVAC is not great, my room was smelling moisture during the stay. The Wifi is sketchy and does not work during peak hours.

I think the hotel does damage the reputation of Marriott and should be rebuilt.
reviews.author: Nicolas Henry

reviews.text: The woman at the front desk tonight made my night. I’ve had a rough day of travel and got stuck in DFW. The woman at the desk tonight with the brown, straight hair is so sweet and deserves a shout out. She works with a smile and is very professional with every guest and treats each one as if they are the only one in the room. Thank you!
reviews.author: Stay580540

reviews.text:
Stayed a couple nights for a funeral. We had a room so that was good but we requested to be placed near the rest of the family and confirmed before we got there but they put us on the other side of the hotel when we actually got there. It appeared they filled the room we discussed earlier but there was a baseball event going on so I understand rooms need filled.

Pool was good.

Elevator wasn’t working. There was no breakfast as advertised. Not even coffee. And the bar was closed completely. The hallway outside of our room was like a furnace, no air whatsoever and the heat and humidity was suffocating on that second floor. It looked smoky, the air was so dense. Housekeeping never came to clean the room until the morning we left.

The bedroom a/c struggled to keep the room cool, it never really got cool but compared to the hallway it was a pleasant feeling to walk in (at first) but it didn’t last long, we were sweating the whole night.

Definitely not a 3 or 4 star hotel, at least not anymore.

Bed was extremely comfortable even though we slept with just a sheet because of the heat, and staff was relatively friendly so they got 2 stars instead of 1.
reviews.author: Anji Monique

reviews.text: So I want to make it clear that my family only stays with Marriott because we have always had great experiences, and then today we stayed here at the Courtyard and from the outside everything was great then we came inside and find the lobby freezing cold are room was not ready and to top it off we were told to give them an hour and they would have our room ready. No the room was not ready we go put in a different room then requested, the shower only had Simi hot water more on the cold side paint peeling off the walls, one of the towels had a long black hair on it the fridge had a half drank water. Just overall not a great experience and I really wouldn’t recommend this location.
reviews.author: Randy Matheson

reviews.text:
This was one of the worst stays in a Marriott hotel that I have ever experienced.

I checked in multiple days in advance with my arrival at 3 pm. When I arrived at the hotel at 3 pm, I was notified that my room was not ready and that there were no clean rooms at the hotel. Additionally, the current wait time was over an hour as they did not have anyone to clean the rooms. The group that I was traveling with booked approximately 30 rooms which results in many finding other hotels after waiting for rooms until 9 pm after arriving at 3 pm. The front desk person never explained the amenities available at the hotel. They never explained breakfast times, anything. 

After getting a room, a hotel staff member entered my room while I was in the shower "just to confirm someone was in the room" as the front desk person, did not enter me in that room. Total disfunction and management from the front. Fast forward to the next morning where the power went out for almost an hour. After the power came back on and woke everyone up, I noticed that my bedsheets were not clean. There was a large brown stain in the foot area of the sheets. I walked out to see when breakfast was at 6:30 am and was told by the front desk worker that breakfast was at 7 am. I returned at 7 am with some of my coworkers and waited until 7:30 when we stopped a woman who appeared to be opening up the breakfast bar area. We asked about breakfast and she replied "there's no breakfast today because we don't know what to do about the food but we have free coffee." This caused 30 people not only to miss their meals but they never offered to try to fix the problem. They gave us complimentary coffee.... thanks. 

People in my group also used the business center in an attempt to print out some form. We were advised that there was no working printer in the hotel so we could not conduct our business as needed.

As I travel a lot and try to stay with Marriott whenever possible, this is the WORST hotel I have ever stayed in.
reviews.author: JMarquissee

reviews.text: Arianna made my visit unforgettable! Her attention to detail and personalized recommendations were spot on. She seemed to genuinely care about my comfort and experience. Courtyard is lucky to have someone like her on the team.
reviews.author: Hazari

reviews.text: Like to stay at local hotels to get some time out of the house. Usually I am not too happy with hotels in this area (even rude at both hiltons) I wanted to try a new hotel and I have not been disappointed with one thing. We have a balcony and it’s so beautiful outside. The room is clean and nice, great bed, and coffee maker, mini fridge and microwave in the room. The lounge is so nice and the employees are so pleasant to talk to. It’s not like a 5 star hotel but they get 5 stars from me.
reviews.author: Coral Sanders

reviews.text: I very much enjoyed the room, atmosphere, service, and the Bistro! BUT the handicap ♿️ rooms were down at the wrong end of the elevator. You had to travel down 2 LOOONG hallways, and as a person unable to walk too far, it was VERY 😒!!!
reviews.author: Curtis Hagar

reviews.text:
Staff was pleasant, but this was offset by a host of problems: the  back security entrance was broken, not locking, so no security; the drawers of the room rolled open [not leveled properly]. card key lock battery failed, so locked out of my room [staff had this fixed promptly to their credit]
Was moved to a new room upstairs; very poor sound insulation [heard neighboring room conversations] shower tub drain partly clogged, so standing in ankle deep water.
Cannot recommend, this facility needs total upgrade, especially sound insulation. Investment required by present owners or new owner willing to make the upgrade.
reviews.author: Ariel 7

reviews.text:
I’m a huge Courtyard fan, and I have a level of expectation for staying at a Courtyard that this hotel missed by miles. First the good: fairly easy access, Starbucks nearby, and the room itself was pretty clean. The room is heated/cooled by one of those motel window air conditioners but controlled by a central control pad. Those aren’t the cleanest, but it kept the room fairly comfortable. 
But overall this felt like I was staying at a highway motel, not a Courtyard. The building is clearly a converted older motel, which isn’t a big deal. But once inside it felt dirty and gross in the hallways and front. (Again, the room itself was clean). The hallways are dark, there is only one elevator on the far back corner, so if you are upstairs you have to walk a very long way. (Be aware, however, that they said first floor rooms have sliding glass doors, so not really safe.) The front cafe is closed due to COVID (understandable!) but is a large, fairly dark empty are right as you walk in, which leads to a feeling of the hotel being half abandoned. The woman who checked me in seemed irritated to be there, and was not very helpful- her replacement a couple of hours later was very sweet and kind, so maybe it was just end of shift fatigue? One big thing— when I went to open my door after dropping off my luggage and running out for dinner, it wouldn’t open. The keycard would unlock it, but then it was like someone had flipped the metal lock on the inside. I tried for 5-6 minutes before hiking all the way down to the front desk, where the nice young lady came back up with me and after a couple of tries it opened. She told me the way the locks are installed, the metal lock sometimes drifts over when you close the door and you just have to keep trying it until it jiggles out of the way. WHAT?!? If you know this is a problem, FIX IT!! Don’t just say “it happens sometimes!” (The hotel, not her...she was really kind.) She was right- about half the time during our stay it happened- taking between 3 tries and 5 minutes to open the door. That alone was enough for me to never stay here again.  
Bottom line: once you are in the room it’s fine....once you are driving away it’s fine. Any time in between is awful.
reviews.author: KrisT

reviews.text: Had to wait 90 mins for the shuttle. Rest everything was good.
reviews.author: Shiva Kandagatla

reviews.text: Arianna provided top-notch service from start to finish. She was always approachable and made excellent recommendations for local attractions. Her enthusiasm and hospitality added so much to our experience.
reviews.author: Fantasy

reviews.text: We booked our room through the wedding block for our friends event.  I called to confirm reservation and check in time with staff.  Very accommodating and friendly.  I checked in online prior to coming and was greeted with a smile, keys and goody bags.  Our room was cool and had nice soft music playing when we arrived.  The room smelled clean and was very inviting.  We enjoyed our stay and would stay here again.  Very close to restaurants and activities.  Great staff!
reviews.author: AngieR

reviews.text: I found this note by my bed when I woke up this morning. Today is June 22,2023. My door was locked with the latch on so I know no one accessed my room while I was sleep. House cleaning hadn’t changed sheets in a month! I alerted the manager and they just told me they will get the sheets changed, like what?? I have already slept on these sheets! They have refused to give me a refund. My other complaints are, they lobby area is always Hot. They do not run the air in the lobby. And the WiFi is Very spotty. This Marriott hotel Sucks!!!!
reviews.author: Mckinley Clark

reviews.text: I chose this location for it's price and proximity to the airport, and the fact that it had a shuttle from one of my discounts via my company - so I did not read the reviews before booking, and now I wish I would have! We arranged for the shuttle to pick us up at 6:15am to take us to the airport with one of the ladies working the front desk, who also happened to be the shuttle driver. Our room was on the far corner of the hotel, and with two kids and an older grandparent, walking places is not fast - this info is important, I promise. The morning of our flight, I get a call to the room at 5:56am. It was the shuttle driver asking what terminal we were at. When I told her, she said that if we could be down to the lobby by 6, that she would be able to take us with the other group (apparently the shuttle was full during sign up the night before, which is why we opted for the 6:15am ride). We were on our way out the door, and made it to the lobby at 6:02am to find that the shuttle had already gone. The lady working the front stated that she had taken the other group, but would make a "special trip" for us at 6:15. We needed to be at the airport at 6:30, so that was okay with us. We waited until 630, and when I asked what happened, she said she was on her way back and was 10 min away. We had to drive to the airport ourselves, luckily making it just in time to board the plane. So what was supposed to be $112 "parking" and overnight for our trip turned out to be $328 since we had to pay $216 for a week's parking at the airport. Aside from that fiasco, I wouldn't stay more than one night. The A/C in the hallways weren't on, and the room needed some work- specifically in the bathroom where the wallpaper was peeling and the shower was dingy. If I could get my hotel room money back, I would be happy, but I know I would likely get a comp'd room, which I wouldn't use, especially at this location. If I could give 0 Stars, I would.
reviews.author: Lisa Sampson

reviews.text: I really had no idea a stay at a Marriott hotel could be this bad. I have almost 4,000 nights at Marriott properties and this is the worst one ever!!! The plumbing does not work.  They tell you to use the bathroom in the lobby until it can be fixed.  Everyone is using the communal bathroom in the lobby so it breaks too.  When I was staying there All the exits on side of the building were closed because parts of the doors were falling off.  The next morning the maintenance man was trying to fix doors and had his wife on speakerphone complaining about how bad the hotel is.  It is ironic that Courtyard is the hotel for business but the wifi is so bad here you can't even check email.
reviews.author: Richard Moore

reviews.text: Worst hotel experience ever. This was no Marriott. Rude staff. The entire building smelled like mold. Our room was dirty and we all had sore throats from breathing in the air. Paint and wallpaper peeling. Rusty fixtures. Filthy carpets. Closet doors would not open. We were supposed to stay three nights, but left early the next morning.  Never again.
reviews.author: Grace Johnson

reviews.text: My husband and I were in town to visit family. This hotel is an older Courtyard design that has been renovated and is as modern as other hotels in which I've recently stayed. All areas were clean - including the outside of the property. Outside entrances are convenient for those who cannot walk long distances. Front desk staff very professional in service and dress. Great stay. I will be back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The lobby was warm and inviting with a huge fireplace. I really loved the design of the lobby ... Very clean lines. Our room was impressive. The bed was comfortable. There were plenty of places to plug devices in to charge. My only complaint was there was no blow dryer in the room. I'm just used to hotels having one so I didn't pack mine.
reviews.author: Tina Herring

reviews.text: Not worthy of Marriott name. Arrived to a front desk clerk having her dinner at front desk with greasy bag sitting on keyboard. The room was not fully cleaned and stocked and we had no housekeeping in 4 days. Went to front desk to ask and were told they had no housekeepers today. I suppose they didn't have any the day before either. The coffee served at the Starbuck counter is obviously not Starbuck standard as it was very weak. They too had no staff one morning. Very disappointed, particularly as Marriott members and myself as a former Marriott staff.
reviews.author: Susanne Krasberg

reviews.text:
We got to hotel 10mins before check in time. Front desk said the room was not ready, to please wait and we will get right on it. An hour and half later and 7 other guests check in, right in front of us I got upset and I'm going to assume the manager showed up and got us in a room. Once in the room there were problem right off the bat. The restroom smelled real bad, almost a mold smell. The toilet tank didn't flush. We had to remove the tank lid to push the dobber down to let the tank fill each time we went to the bathroom.  The door locks or the frame where the lock goes looked like it needed to be repaired. The door would swing everytime the outside door opened from the wind. At night we had 2 different people try to get in to the room by accident I'm sure. The door would push almost open, but the lock latched. It was a bit disturbing.  The front desk was called and NO ONE CAME TO FIX THESE PROBLEMS. I would not recommend this hotel at all. When we checked out not one person said anything to us about the problems
Didn't even look at us just asked what we needed. I said I need a hard copy receipt.  I got it and left.
reviews.author: Larry Castillo

reviews.text:
The Courtyard is located close to everything, easy access to the highways and many different food offerings. The room was very clean and the suite was comfortable for my needs. I have stayed at Courtyard's before and they are always reliable, you know what you are getting for a decent price.

If you have family, the suites work best so children can sleep in one room while adults can talk in the living space. A great arrangement, allowing personal space.

If I have any complaints they are small, I was on the ground floor close to the pool so a chlorine smell was in the hallway. For breakfast I ordered a muffin, it was definitely a day old and not fresh. Evenings I ate out with family.
reviews.author: ked

reviews.text: My family and I stayed here this week Feb. 15- 18 because of the power outage with the snow storm. When I first called Monday morning the lady up front was very helpful and kind. We extended our stay since power was not on after the first night and although they were booking up fast she and the staff remained professional even with the phones going crazy! Our stay was great, rooms were clean and it was warm the entire time. So blessed we called this place when we did and they took care of my family so my kiddos didn’t freeze.
reviews.author: Blush N Beauty Spa

reviews.text:
This is an older Courtyard with patios and balconies in practically every room. The sliding door didn't look that secure. The room was clean, but it needed a bit of maintenance. The bathroom was spacious, and they should've used some of that to widen the shower. Or make that top shelf in the shower have a curve like the bottom one. I'd watch your elbow when showering, even with soap in your eyes.

The WiFi speed is very slow.

The elevator is on the other end of the property from the check-in desk, and the carpet is thick enough to slow down wheeled luggage.

The fitness center has a lot of room and a decent amount of equipment; however, there is no bench! Also, the lighting in the bigger section is poor. I'd imagine the area would be brighter in the daylight because of the wall of windows. This was the first time I saw that touchscreen on that cable machine. It waa very helpful as I learned a few exercises to so with that machine now. The TV and water dispenser were out of commission.

The menu for the Stay for Breakfast rate is not the same as the regular menu at the cafe.

The staff were friendly and helpful and had to put up with a hot lobby. The rooms were cold though. There was an excessive heat warning that day, so maybe they were trying to conserve energy.

TV is old as time, the Continental breakfast is non existent here. The pillows well your he sinks into them. They should probably get pillows that do not consist of harming animals for the feathers. Coffee pot In room was not plugged. The little bottles they have of shampoo is not enough for half of my hair. The room I stayed in  was hot even with AC @ 62.  No trash bags for trash cans.  WOW NEVER AGAIN
reviews.author: Mandie Aranda

reviews.text: We've stayed here many times but this 2 night stay will be our last.  It took 30 minutes to check in even tho I called twice to make sure all was set.  Bistro out of milk for breakfast.  First floor room, could hear traffic.  Moved to 3rd floor and the heating was such that even when set at "low", it would come on "full blast" waking one up.  Just awful.  We were told this room was one of the first to be "refurbished" but if Marriott uses these heating elements, they are making a mistake.  Thus, we will find another place to stay when we return to Grapevine.
reviews.author: Judy Hines

reviews.text: The staff are friendly and makes you welcome, Tonya from the front desk showed a lot of enthusiasm, friendly and quiet helpful.  Rooms are clean and spacious, amenities well maintained and up to date, beds are really comfortable
reviews.author: Ananth Mariappan

reviews.text: Shakina’s kindness and attention to detail set her apart. She took the time to ensure we felt comfortable and welcomed, and her service truly exceeded our expectations. Courtyard is lucky to have her!
reviews.author: Mystic Shade

reviews.text: I am a platinum elite member, I travel a lot for work, and I usually am happy with Marriott properties. Although I checked in through the app and said I would be there at 11 PM (my flight arrived at 9:45 PM), they did not have a room available.  The front desk clerk said "you can't just show up at 11 and expect a room," so I'm wondering why offer the online check in if the hotels don't recognize your request. They did offer us their "one last smoking room", like it was a gift, but that was not an option for us. After waiting in the lobby for about an hour, trying to call other hotels at midnight to find a place to stay, they suddenly had a room ready for us. When I asked what happened they revealed they did not have housekeeping to clean rooms, so they had to call someone in to clean. Which if they had told us that initially, we would have just waited with no issue. Also,  the entire time we were there, there was no heat in the lobby and there was a freeze in the DFW area. We did use the Bistro the first morning, and the poor girl was working in 30 degree temps inside. Then the last two days we were there, she was sick, so they just put a pot of coffee out. I am very disappointed in this Marriott property and would recommend staying elsewhere.
reviews.author: CarolineS

reviews.text: Great location, easy access and a super staff. This hotel features expansive rooms with comfortable beds with super soft pillows. I easily fell asleep in a bed not my own. Definitely ask for a room with a shower if you don't take baths. The showers are big and perfect for relaxing after a hard day on the road.
reviews.author: DFWFreqTraveler

reviews.text: This Courtyard hotel met all of our overnight needs.  The ease off the interstate is a plus, yet one cannot hear traffic noise.  The pool area inside the courtyard was very nice. We have stayed at this location before.  The beds are so comfortable we bought our bed from the same supplier.  The room was cozy as it has a nice love seat for viewing t.v. and a separate desk.  Good wifi connection. This is a modern, extremely clean hotel.  We are typically accustomed to complementary continental breakfast.  One is not included here.  Close to several restaurant options.  I would highly recommend.
reviews.author: DeborahTackett

reviews.text: Smelly hallways, dirty room with hair all over, no trash bags for trash cans. Housekeeping obviously does the bare minimum. They let a bunch of kids scream in the pool until 1130 pm. There's better hotels nearby. Do not come here
reviews.author: Scholastic Book Fair

reviews.text: Overall the staff was very friendly the room was spacious the air conditioner worked great.  Location was great.   Easy access to many restaurants and AT&T Center and 6 flags.  The pool was closed which was unfortunate.  We did find a big spider in the room.  On the last day our toilet overflowed to the point of soaking the entire bathroom and entry way.
reviews.author: NatalieGill

reviews.text: Our was simply just OK. You cannot enter through any doors except main entrance which is hard for a person with disabilities. Then it’s a very long hallway walk to the elevator. Once we arrived on the 3rd floor, there was a party happening at midnight. Kids were playing in hallway and it was very loud. We tried to make the best of it because we were exhausted. King size bed is very firm. The shower has a little mold in in. Room 355 if anyone is wondering. We left after 5 hours. Will not stay here again unless emergency
reviews.author: Sleepywithnorest

reviews.text: I stay at this location often so I do not have to commute as far. I was not as happy this last week. On first stay this week the room had hardly any light because light bulbs didn't work I asked to fix and didn't but wanted to move me which was not convenient. The 2nd room I stayed in smelled like sewage off and on, lingering ants, and the laundry room dryer didn't work. I do have to say the staff is always pleasant to work with unless it is Johnny she is never that pleasant and rough almost rude most times. Also I wish this site like almost all of the others had breakfast but it doesn't. They do have a service bar in the am. you can buy something.
reviews.author: JoAnna Rodrigues

reviews.text:
It’s the only place I will stay when I return again for work. The entire staff was friendly and accommodating! The facility and the room were clean. The patio room was refreshing and just what I needed when I got back from work. The pool area was very nice. The location was perfect, central to everything. 
It was a great stay!
reviews.author: MichelleE

reviews.text: Lobby and rooms have standard modern Courtyard design, everything else feels dated by about 30 years. Big crickets in the halls, both ice makers broken, only one elevator in the very back of the building, entire first floor smells strongly of stale chlorine, toilets have trouble flushing, beds are uncomfortable, room A/C can't keep up (and it's only 85 outside), and there seems to be no A/C in the hallways. I've literally stayed at nicer Motel 6s. All that being said the room was clean and safe, the property is conveniently located, and the staff was helpful.
reviews.author: Noelle Lewis

reviews.text: The staff was welcoming,  which is always nice.  I was able to get an early check in. Breakfast is 6-9 and the bar/ restaurant is 5-9 I believe. I wasn't a fan on my room. Seemed a bit outdated. I had a small balcony, but couldn't keep the door open because there was no screen. The cute round like couch in the room needed a cleaning and the room seemed a bit small. Good thing it was only me. The upside; there are plenty of places to eat. Walking distance!

I want to say that when we first walked it felt so nice and clean. We’re moving my sister, so when we came back from packing we were well greeted by Jenny. After packing all we wanted to do was get a drink and relax. Jenny was so nice and we had such a nice time chatting with her and just feeling like we were hanging out, comfortable and Jenny was our host. She took such good care of us. Thank you so much Jenny! We will always remember how you made us feel welcomed and loved!!!

My stay here was amazing no complaints room was spacious enjoyed the balcony view! The housekeeper Lita was awesome I used room 215 yesterday and she gave me extra coffee and towels since I had late check out.  She had informed me to do review and I just wanted to kindly thank her for working and servicing my needs.  You are appreciated more then you know! Thank you Lita you rock!
Tee

Upon our arrival, we were greeted with a big smile at the front desk and a quick check-in . When we got to our room, it was a bit warm, and we couldn't adjust the temperature. I called the front desk, and the property's engineer, Edwin, was in our room in 4 minutes fixing the problem. This made me ask him how many engineers there were on the property, since I had seen him shampooing the carpets in the hallways, picking up trash, and doing other things. When he replied that he was the only one, I

Colton is beyond extraordinary! He proved time and again that he is willing to go above and beyond to accommodate his customers but also just has an essence of kindness and respect shown to every person. If I could give me more than five stars, I would with no hesitation! This was my first time needing a hotel based on delayed flights and as soon as I walked in and spoke with him, my nerves were gone and I felt cared for. He is truly an asset to the team and a wonderful person. Keep shining brig

Nice hotel. Secluded so not a lot of traffic noise. Close to jump on freeway. Easy trips to airport, AT&T Stadium, Global Life Stadium, Six Flags. Friendly staff, large nice tv, comfy bed, nice outdoor pool. Only complaint...had to let shower run for a bit to get hot water (very odd).

I was booked here for one night by American Airlines due to a delayed, then cancelled, flight. The hotel shuttle arrived right around 8:30 pm as promised by AA. The driver had a bit of an attitude, not toward me, but to a man who attempted to get on the shuttle at the next terminal. He was in his 70s (I think) and had a walking stick. The driver didn't get out to open the door and help him. The man fell whilst trying to get into the shuttle. Once at the hotel, the very handsome man who checked m

We got to the room later in the evening after a full day or work and travel, we were ready for bed. We walked into our room and were hit in the face with a terrible musty moldy smell. It smelt like the room had flooded and then just sat there unattended. I have asthma and am allergic to mold, so this made the situation very unsafe for me!
We stayed in the room the 1st night due to not thinking we had much of an option. The next morning, I went to the front desk to see what could be done. I was g

My stay here has been great. Especially a huge compliment to Jenny at the Bistro! She had incredible hospitality and went above and beyond to make our experience amazing. She got our food out right away and genuinely cared about making our day better. Jenny is the kind of person who makes Marriott stand out — truly exceptional service!
